title: A First Look at Starlink Performance
authors: François Michel; Martino Trevisan; Danilo Giordano; Olivier Bonaventure
affiliations: UCLouvain, University of Trieste, Politecnico di Torino

problem_statement.en: Interactive latency, packet loss, throughput and application behavior change under loaded satellite access.
problem_statement.zh: interactive latency、packet loss、throughput 與 application behavior 隨 loaded satellite access 改變。

key_innovation.en: Run periodic RIPE-anchor pings and Ookla tests, controlled QUIC transfers and BrowserTime experiments; publish a trace-based ERRANT emulation model.
key_innovation.zh: 執行 periodic RIPE-anchor pings、Ookla tests、controlled QUIC transfers 與 BrowserTime experiments；公開 trace-based ERRANT emulation model。

baselines_compared: GEO access, wired 1 Gbps, HTTP/2, HTTP/3

key_improvements.en: The nearby-anchor minimum RTTs shown in the paper fall near 20–29 ms. Loaded-transfer experiments reveal queue-related latency and losses beyond those minimum values.
key_improvements.zh: 論文中 nearby-anchor minimum RTTs 約為 20–29 ms。loaded-transfer experiments 揭示額外 queue-related latency 與 losses。

evidence: §2 measurement setup, Table 1; §3 network; §4 web; §5 QUIC and emulator, PDF pp.3–8

scope.en: One Belgian terminal and the early-2022 deployment define this measurement regime. Subsequent constellation and terminal revisions benefit from fresh calibration.
scope.zh: 單一 Belgian terminal 與 early-2022 deployment 定義量測 regime。後續 constellation 與 terminal revisions 需要新 calibration。

model.en: Empirical latency/throughput distributions, packet-loss reconstruction, load-dependent RTT and trace-driven access emulation.
model.zh: empirical latency/throughput distributions、packet-loss reconstruction、load-dependent RTT 與 trace-driven access emulation。

evaluation.en: Five months of latency probes to 11 RIPE anchors, four months of speed tests and top-120 Belgian websites; 100 MB HTTP/3 transfers and light real-time QUIC message streams.
evaluation.zh: 五個月對 11 個 RIPE anchors 的 latency probes；四個月 speed tests 與 Belgian top-120 websites；100 MB HTTP/3 transfers 與 light real-time QUIC message streams。
